key_provisions_or_claims: Sets competent authority requirements and procedures for certification, oversight and enforcement of continuing airworthiness of certified UAS.
Member States designate competent authorities with powers to audit, inspect (including unannounced) and enforce.
Level 1 and level 2 findings system with suspension, limitation or revocation of certificates.
Risk-based oversight and survey programmes; oversight cycle not exceeding 24 months.
Amends Implementing Regulation 2023/203 to extend information security risk management to UAS authorities; applies from 1 May 2025.
annotation.summary_en: EU Commission Implementing Regulation 2024/1109 sets competent authority requirements and administrative procedures for certifying, overseeing and enforcing continuing airworthiness of certified unmanned aircraft systems (drones), and extends information security risk rules to those authorities. Applies from 1 May 2025.
